Ava (Product): Quick sync — I'm proposing a Migration Onramp playbook for new tenants moving to regional slices. Strawman checklist below (short). Please react with :thumbsup: if this is reasonable or propose changes.

Marcus (Arch): LGTM overall. Two asks: 1) explicit routing precedence for SLA bands, 2) fallback semantics for region-unavailable.

Priya (Eng): +1. Need perf budget per slice (p90 latency target, token throughput). Also suggest `canary_percent` param.

Liam (SRE): Add obs requirements: trace_id propagation, per-tenant error rates, 5m burn-rate alert (>=5% errors) and rollback playbook.

Nadia (Solutions): From customer side — they want pinning to model version + soft-fallback instead of full failover for data residency cases.

Ava (Product): here's the strawman checklist:
- Launch gating: SR (support runbook), infra readiness, perf cert (p90 <= 120ms), ops playbook
- Contract bands: dev (best-effort), standard (SLO 99.5), enterprise (SLA 99.95 + region isolation)
- Routing policy outlines: prefer-local -> reserved -> burst -> fallback (region) -> degrade-model
- Canary: 1% traffic for 24h -> 5% for 72h -> gradual ramp
- Rollback criteria: >5% error or p95 latency > 2x baseline for 30m

Marcus (Arch): also propose policy YAML for the route precedence:
```
route_policy:
  - name: prefer_local
    priority: 100
  - name: reserved_pool
    priority: 90
  - name: burst
    priority: 80
  - name: cross_region_fallback
    priority: 50
  - name: degrade_model
    priority: 10
```

Priya (Eng): Implementation note — we should expose `routing_policy` in tenant config and make it immutable post onboarding for enterprise customers.

Liam (SRE): Ops checklist for go/no-go:
- perf cert against seed workload
- tracing & logs enabled
- canary alerting wired to pager
- capacity buffer (+20%) on day 1

Ava (Product): Next steps: Marcus to draft policy DSL + eval hooks, Priya to estimate infra work and perf cert signal, Liam to draft runbook. Let's sync Thur 9am. @ops-bot please schedule.

ops-bot: Event scheduled: Architecture Onramp Sync — Thu 09:00 (calendar invite sent to participants).

Nadia (Solutions): I'll pre-collect 3 customer onboarding asks to bring to the sync.

Ava (Product): Thanks all — if you have objections comment inline, otherwise I'll convert this into a PR for the roadmap doc.
